text: REJECT: the patch only extracts the ship, state-recording and close-out blocks, which by my rough count remove about 50 of the 73 complexity points. The rest of `RunTurnAsync`, including everything before line 299, is untouched, so it likely still sits well above the threshold of 15. I didn't build or run anything, and I couldn't verify the new helper signatures (`Dropped`, the `parked` tuple type, the `planned` element type) against the surrounding code.
